functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup table entry directly jumps to the screen-aim initializer.

functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init
functions.evidence: Stores 320.0 and 240.0 in the two members of the verified freeware_aim_screen global.

functions.name: config_init_defaults_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup entry that jumps to the game config initializer.

functions.name: config_init_defaults
functions.evidence: Initializes the persisted config record used by freeware_save_config, including its display settings and both players’ bindings.

functions.name: sprite_effect_alloc_slot
functions.evidence: Called by fx_spawn_sprite to scan the 256 sprite-effect records.

functions.name: freeware_score_key_init
functions.evidence: Fills the 243-byte key table from game mode, player count and byte index.

functions.name: freeware_score_encode
functions.evidence: Adds the repeating 243-byte key to the payload and appends its weighted checksum.

functions.name: freeware_score_decode
functions.evidence: Subtracts the same repeating key and tests the weighted checksum stored after the payload.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Jumps directly to the static score table initializer.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init
functions.evidence: Constructs the 100 score records with default name 10tons, using the same table as the loader.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_reset
functions.evidence: Called by the score loader before fopen. Visits all 100 score records, assigns the default name and clears scores.
